intro: Sierra Leone is a presidential republic with regular elections.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years, up to two terms. Julius Maada Bio was re-elected in 2023. Parliament has a single chamber.

chapters.title: Peace
text: A Special Court tried leaders for war crimes, including Liberia's Charles Taylor.
